title: Shared Rulebook
objective: Build one compact set of shared rules that lets every scene finish without contamination, collision, or incorrect machine access.
world_rules: Every scene uses a 10 by 10 warehouse and the same rule language. Walls shape which routes are available.
Robots choose the shortest legal route. If routes are equally short, they choose the one with fewer turns.
If multiple robots enter the same square in the same step, they collide.
A robot that reaches a floor target stops there. A robot that finishes at a machine leaves the station after that step.
A target square is being entered by multiple robots when at least two robots currently intend to enter it.
Carrying a spill into cold storage can contaminate the shared area. A cleaner can enter with a spill without causing contamination.
A machine is used by entering its square. Only one robot can enter it per step.
At setup machines, an operator must enter first to prepare the station; a carrier can enter after the operator releases it.
The same shared rulebook applies to every scene.

rule_schema.canonicalization: The interface accepts up to eight conditions. The exact solver collapses logically equivalent categorical descriptions.

ground_truth_design.curriculum_logic: A broad safety rule is refined by legitimate counterexamples. A road convention and a machine-priority norm are then learned. A cross-context counterexample forces the road convention to be scoped away from machines before all three norms are reused in one causally linked scene.

global_solver.prior: uniform over canonical rules before behavioral evidence
global_solver.search_cost_definition: canonical rulebooks enumerated in increasing rule count and MDL after evidence-based pruning; participant attempts are not search cost
global_solver.scope_note: Exact for rulebooks whose component rules each solve at least one layer-1 or layer-2 learning trial alone. Any submitted rulebook is still evaluated directly, including ungrounded shortcuts.

tasks.label: T1
tasks.description: One robot must reach its target in a warehouse containing cold storage.
tasks.participant_prompt: Run the scene, inspect what goes wrong, and decide whether the shared rulebook should be added to or refined.

analysis.evidence_function: A single visible externality makes a broad protective norm a reasonable first hypothesis.

tasks.label: T2
tasks.description: Two robots must reach their targets through the warehouse.
tasks.participant_prompt: Run the scene, inspect what goes wrong, and decide whether the shared rulebook should be added to or refined.

analysis.evidence_function: Two robots approach the same ordinary square. A direction-based yielding convention can coordinate them without assigning IDs.
analysis.expected_transition: no road norm -> contested eastbound yielding

tasks.label: T3
tasks.description: Two robots must complete their targets at the same machine.
tasks.participant_prompt: Run the scene, inspect what goes wrong, and decide whether the shared rulebook should be added to or refined.

analysis.evidence_function: An operator must prepare a shared station before a carrier uses it, making role-based priority useful.
analysis.expected_transition: no machine norm -> carrier yields at a contested machine

tasks.label: T4
tasks.description: Two robots must reach their targets in a warehouse containing cold storage.
tasks.participant_prompt: Run the scene, inspect what goes wrong, and decide whether the shared rulebook should be added to or refined.

analysis.evidence_function: A legitimate clean delivery is a counterexample to banning everyone from cold storage.

tasks.label: T5
tasks.description: All robots must reach their targets in a warehouse containing cold storage.
tasks.participant_prompt: Run the scene, inspect what goes wrong, and decide whether the shared rulebook should be added to or refined.

analysis.evidence_function: A cleaner carrying a spill is a legitimate exception, while an operator carrying the same spill remains harmful.

tasks.label: T6
tasks.description: Three robots must reach their targets through the warehouse.
tasks.participant_prompt: Run the scene, inspect what goes wrong, and decide whether the shared rulebook should be added to or refined.

analysis.evidence_function: Two local conflicts have different locations and different pairs of roles, but share one priority structure. The operator has priority at both junctions; carrier and cleaner yield.
analysis.expected_transition: specific role rules -> one reusable non-operator priority rule

optimality.hypothesis_space: all canonical MOVE rules up to eight conditions

tasks.label: T7
tasks.description: Four robots must reach their targets in a warehouse containing a machine.
tasks.participant_prompt: Run the scene, inspect what goes wrong, and decide whether the shared rulebook should be added to or refined.

analysis.evidence_function: A broad carrier-yields rule would also block the carrier on an ordinary road. The machine type must scope the role-based norm.
analysis.expected_transition: broad carrier priority -> machine-scoped carrier priority

tasks.label: T8
tasks.description: Three robots must reach their targets in a warehouse containing cold storage.
tasks.participant_prompt: Run the scene, inspect what goes wrong, and decide whether the shared rulebook should be added to or refined.

analysis.evidence_function: Avoiding cold storage changes a robot's route and creates a later junction conflict, so both earlier norms are jointly needed.
analysis.expected_transition: jointly retain precise safety and road norms

tasks.label: T9
tasks.description: Four robots must reach their targets in a warehouse containing cold storage and a machine.
tasks.participant_prompt: Run the scene, inspect what goes wrong, and decide whether the shared rulebook should be added to or refined.

analysis.evidence_function: Avoiding cold storage delays an operator until a carrier reaches the same station, so safety and machine priority must coexist.
analysis.expected_transition: jointly retain precise safety and machine norms

tasks.label: T10
tasks.description: All robots must reach their targets in a warehouse containing cold storage and a machine.
tasks.participant_prompt: Run the scene, inspect what goes wrong, and decide whether the shared rulebook should be added to or refined.

analysis.evidence_function: One operator's detour links contamination prevention, junction coordination, and machine priority in a single workflow.
analysis.expected_transition: retrieve and jointly apply the three refined cached norms
